title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.3.7 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance. v0.3.5 model-picker UX: dropped the prescriptive '★ RECOMMENDED' badge on 31B-it (every variant card is now visually equal — user picks freely); the loader-log panel auto-expands the instant a variant is clicked so the user sees per-phase output (download / unsloth init / GPU transfer) without an extra click; the status pane surfaces the most recent 2 non-heartbeat log lines inline so phase transitions are visible without glancing at the bottom panel. v0.3.4: three pending tasks closed. (1) Persona library migrated to curator-JSON (_personas.json) — 7 expert personas ship in the wheel: NGO intake, lawyer research, regulator audit, journalist fact-check, researcher tagging, worker-side advocate, skeptical safety reviewer. New /api/personas endpoint, persona modal lists curated + user customs + clone-and-edit affordance. (2) Examples modal gains a use-case chip filter row (worker_asking / ngo_intake / lawyer_research / regulator_audit / journalist_fact_check / researcher_tagging / adversarial_recruiter) — picking a chip narrows the visible categories to those matching the audience. (3) Expert-mode rubric category dropdown rewritten as chip picker — best-fit + cross-cutting rubrics shown prominently, mismatched ones collapsed behind a 'Show others' toggle. Carries v0.3.3 dead-code purge, v0.3.2 polish (AbortController, tooltips, mobile tables), v0.3.0 Brave BYOK. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
